labs.lab_name: Institute of Politics at Harvard Kennedy School
labs.research_summary: A non-partisan institute at Harvard Kennedy School, founded in 1966, that engages mainly undergraduates with politicians, practitioners and academics through a public forum, resident fellows, student programs, internships and a national youth poll.
labs.member_breakdown: 1 director, 1 executive director, 1 counselor, 1 senior advisor, 16 program, communications, polling and administrative staff
